en.headline: Tertiary student sentenced to 10 years for sexual offences against underage girls
en.dek: High Court Judge Andrew Chan noted the 22-year-old showed no remorse after one 14-year-old victim took her own life following an attempted rape.
body: The High Court on Thursday sentenced Fan Chi-yuen, a 22-year-old associate degree student in psychology, to 10 years in prison after he admitted 12 charges related to sexual offences against at least four underage girls.

Judge Andrew Chan Hing-wai said assessment reports showed Fan had no remorse or empathy for his victims. One of them, a 14-year-old girl he met on the social media platform RedNote in August 2023, took her own life two weeks after he molested her at a hotel. Her mother later found messages in which the girl described the assault.

The charges included attempted rape, indecent assault, and offences related to child pornography. The court heard Fan arranged meetings with the girls at hotels between 2022 and 2023. Prosecutors said the offences were premeditated. Fan had pleaded guilty, and the sentence was reduced for his admission of the charges.

zh.headline: 大專生承認性侵未成年少女等12罪 判監10年
zh.dek: 高等法院法官陳慶偉指22歲被告范致遠毫無悔意，其中一名14歲受害人遭企圖強奸後輕生。
body: 高等法院周四裁定，22歲副學士心理學學生范致遠承認12項控罪後，被判監禁10年。控罪涉及最少4名未成年少女的性罪行。
法官陳慶偉表示，評估報告顯示范致遠對受害人毫無悔意或同理心。其中一名14歲少女於2023年8月透過社交平台小紅書認識被告，其後在酒店被非禮，兩星期後輕生。少女母親其後在其通訊紀錄中發現相關描述。
控罪包括企圖強奸、非禮及兒童色情物品相關罪行。案情指被告於2022至2023年間約未成年少女到酒店見面，行為屬有計劃。被告已認罪，判刑已考慮認罪扣減。
